author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Blake Treinen (elbow) playing catch
desc: Blake Treinen has resumed playing catch.
impact: Treinen was placed on the 15-day injured list on June 20 with right elbow inflammation. He has begun a throwing program, but is not expected to return until after the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Enrique Hernandez (oblique) yet to begin swinging
desc: Enrique Hernandez continues to ramp up his baseball activities but has yet to begin swinging.
impact: Hernandez has been sidelined since May 27 due to a significant tear in his left oblique. It remains unclear when he'll begin swinging, but he continues to progress through baseball activities, which is a positive step. He is expected to return from the injured list in late July or early August.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kris Bubic (elbow/shoulder) receives cortisone injection Thursday
desc: Kris Bubic received a cortisone injection on Thursday.
impact: Bubic was scratched from his minor league rehab appearance on Wednesday due to shoulder soreness. He received a cortisone injection the following day and will be shut down for 7-10 days before resuming a throwing progression.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Blas Castano (pectoral) hopes to begin throwing by Sunday
desc: Blas Castano is hopeful to begin throwing by Sunday.
impact: Castano has been sidelined since June 21 with a right pectoral strain. He was originally expected to begin a throwing program June 29, but he appeared to still be dealing with discomfort. He remains without a timetable for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Edward Cabrera (hamstring/adductor) hopeful to throw bullpen before break
desc: The Chicago Cubs are hopeful that Edward Cabrera can throw a bullpen session before the All-Star break.
impact: Cabrera suffered a strain in both his left hamstring and left adductor while stretching to receive a throw at first base on June 23 against the New York Mets. He remains without a timetable for his return, though one could emerge once he begins throwing off a mound.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cody Freeman (neck) to begin baseball activities in about three weeks
desc: Cody Freeman underwent surgery to repair a herniated disk in his neck on June 29 and is expected to begin baseball activities in approximately three weeks.
impact: Freeman has been on the 10-day injured list since June 25 with a herniated disk in his neck and has yet to be transferred to the 60-day injured list. A timetable for his return should emerge once he resumes baseball activities.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cody Bradford (elbow) throws live BP Thursday
desc: Cody Bradford threw a live batting practice session on Thursday.
impact: Bradford continues to work his way back from the setback he suffered in April during his recovery from UCL surgery. He has been on a throwing program for the past eight weeks and is now facing live hitters. Bradford is expected to throw one more live batting practice session before beginning a minor league rehab assignment.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Dustin May (ankle) has X-rays return negative
desc: Dustin May underwent X-rays after exiting Thursday's game against the Atlanta Braves, and the results came back negative.
impact: May exited in the first inning with a right ankle contusion after being struck by a line drive. He said after the game that X-rays came back negative and that his ankle was hurting at the moment. Fantasy managers can consider him day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shea Langeliers will not participate in Home Run Derby
desc: Shea Langeliers told reporters "no" when asked he's interested in participating in the Home Run Derby.
impact: Langeliers is top-10 in the MLB with 20 home runs so far this season. He is one of several players who have said they aren't participating.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Creed Willems (hamstring) placed on minor league IL
desc: Creed Willems was placed on the minor league injured list.
impact: Willems left Wednesday's game due to left hamstring discomfort. He is the Orioles No. 17 prospect per MLB Pipeline.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew McCutchen signs minor league deal with Braves
desc: The Braves have signed Andrew McCutchen to a minor league contract.
impact: McCutchen hit .192 in 83 plate appearances for the Texas Rangers this season. He was released on May 28.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Freddy Fermin to be evaluated for concussion
desc: The Padres are evaluating Freddy Fermin for a concussion.
impact: There should be an update on Fermin on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Vasquez taken to emergency room after fainting Thursday
desc: Randy Vasquez fainted when he left the game on Thursday and was taken to the emergency room.
impact: Per Heilbrunn, Vasquez is "ok." There should be an update on his status on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sam McWilliams signs minor league deal with Boston
desc: The Red Sox signed RHP Sam McWilliams to a minor league contract.
impact: McWilliams will add more pitching depth in the Red Sox organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Suarez activated from paternity list
desc: The Athletics activated LHP José Suarez from the paternity list.
impact: Suarez returns to the Athletics after being away for a few days.
